name: gouache
style: a naturalistic painted aerial view in opaque gouache, seen strictly from straight above like a satellite image (no perspective, no side of anything visible, mountains as broad rugged ranges of ridges lit on their upper-left slopes and shaded on the lower-right), soft painterly blending of the land in calm natural greens, ochres and blues, one warm light from the top left; no outlines; what a player acts on (towns with warm terracotta roofs and cream stone, resources that sparkle, roads and fields) stands out from the quieter land
